g.text: Model-implied versus realized ROI: every declared 5% strategy alternative
Ablation pools four seasons with 1,000 initial capital per season; all strategies retain their recorded stakes.
Dashed line: realized ROI = model-implied ROI. Gray segments connect fixed and quarter-Kelly alternatives; each panel has its own scale.
Codes F/K identify staking alternatives; numbered keys retain all eight first-study and all 22 pooled ablation rows.
Model-implied ROI = Σ stake × (probability × decimal odds − 1) / Σ stake: conditional on allocated stakes, not predicted terminal wealth.
These are retrospective archived-price results. The ablation is exploratory; 2025–26 was already examined. No executed returns or selected winner are claimed.
